subject: Isolated site certificate handoff and expedited patch path
messages:
From: Aaron Hollis <aaron.hollis@edgeops.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Containr Logistics <courier@containr.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sterile site delivery proposal + ETA for signed artifact bundle

Ben / Marissa,

Following our call this morning: EdgeOps will deliver the sealed artifact bundle for Site-4432 (islanded cluster) via our ground courier on Friday, Apr 30th. The package will contain the signed firmware/image bundle and the operator keyset. High-level: 

- Courier ETA: 2027-04-30 10:00-13:00 PT
- Transfer model: sealed crate with tamper tape, manifest signed by two EdgeOps signers
- Signing: Ed25519 detached signatures, manifest includes SHA-256 digests for each artifact
- On-site ops: we will hand the crate to your designated operator team and provide a paper copy of the signer roster

Requesting confirmation of acceptance window and a list of the on-site operator identities who will sign acceptance. Also please confirm the validation script we should run on receipt (we'll include a verifier checksum utility).

Attachments: manifest-v3.json (signed), signer-roster.pdf (stapled)

Thanks,
Aaron
Aaron Hollis
EdgeOps Field Delivery
aaron.hollis@edgeops.io
+1 (415) 555-0172

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Aaron Hollis <aaron.hollis@edgeops.io>, Containr Logistics <courier@containr.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sterile site delivery proposal + ETA for signed artifact bundle

Aaron — thanks, this is helpful. A few acceptance and escalation notes from our side before we lock the window: 

Acceptance checklist (must pass before operator signs for crate):
- Manifest digest verification against attached manifest-v3.json and detached signatures
- Signer roster cross-check (names + government ID) with our ops roster
- Package tamper-evidence inspection and serial number match
- Offline verifier execution: checksum verification and signature verification (we prefer Ed25519)

On-site operator roster (people who can accept and will sign):
- Ben Carter (on-call backup)
- Jonas Weber (primary)
- Kimberly Park (observer for transport chain)

Please confirm that:
1) EdgeOps will provide both electronic (USB sealed) and paper copies of the signer-roster;
2) Manifest contains the pre-computed HMAC of the artifact set (for a quick early check) and the detached Ed25519 signatures;
3) There's a documented emergency-elevated-patch path if an urgent hotfix must be applied before the next scheduled cycle (details below).

Emergency/expedited patch path (short):
- Pre-authorized emergency signer list (subset of signer-roster)
- Dual-sign requirement + on-site witness log (photo of signature page)
- HSM-assisted key unwrap at our edge enclave and pre-registered KMS wrapping key id

If you can attach the actual signed manifest and courier waybill, we'll circulate to our field ops and get the acceptance window confirmed.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions (Redwood Inference)
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Aaron Hollis <aaron.hollis@edgeops.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Containr Logistics <courier@containr.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 14:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sterile site delivery proposal + ETA for signed artifact bundle

Ben — attached the requested artifacts. We included both the JSON manifest with detached signatures and a scanned copy of the signer roster. Emergency signer list is embedded under manifest.emergency_signers. Courier waybill attached; the crate serial is CR-EO-4432-77. 

Notes about wrapping and KMS: EdgeOps will not perform any remote key unwrap at the site — all keys are transported in operator hardware tokens. For the expedited patch path we propose: 

- A pre-shared KMS wrapping key id: edgeops-wrap-v1 (edgeops KMS) — Redwood will provide your KMS public-verification token and we will include the wrap metadata in the manifest.
- Dual-sign required for any emergency hotfix payloads (two independent EdgeOps officers)
- On receipt, Redwood operator executes our supplied offline-verifier.sh to check digests/signatures; if an emergency patch is required we will deliver a sealed emergency packet signed by emergency_signers and identify the courier batch id for fast-tracking.

Attachments: manifest-v3.json (application/json, detached signatures included), signer-roster.pdf (paper copy scanned), courier-waybill.pdf

Regards,
Aaron

[attachment: manifest-v3.json (application/json)]
[attachment: signer-roster.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 10:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sterile site delivery proposal + ETA for signed artifact bundle

Folks — reviewed the manifest and signatures. Good first pass. A couple of operational additions for the on-site acceptance script and post-signoff traceability: 

On-site acceptance script (run as root on the airgapped host before installing):
- Verify all artifact SHA-256 digests against manifest-v3.json
- Run offline-verifier.sh to validate Ed25519 detached signatures and check emergency_signers block
- Log output (stdout + signatures) to acceptance-log-<timestamp>.log and write to the crate acceptance folder on the operator USB
- Photograph crate seals and signer IDs; checksum the photos and store checksum as photo_manifest.txt

Post-signoff:
- Operator to upload acceptance-log and photo_manifest.txt to secure S3 ingress (job HS-3245) once the site regains network connectivity
- Retain physical paperwork in the customer vault and scan with notarized witness stamp

I've attached a trimmed verifier script that we will use (lightweight, POSIX-compatible). It expects manifest-v3.json and offline-verifier.sh from EdgeOps.

CC: Kimberly — please confirm operator rotation and who will carry the acceptance USB.

-Jonas
Senior Site Reliability (Redwood Inference)
[attachment: offline-verifier.sh (text/x-sh)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 24 Apr 2027 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sterile site delivery proposal + ETA for signed artifact bundle

Thanks everyone — operator rotation and chain-of-custody notes: 

Operator schedule for Apr 30 acceptance window:
- Primary acceptor: Jonas Weber (onsite lead)
- Secondary acceptor: Kimberly Park (transport chain observer)
- Backup on-call: Karthik Iyer (remote support)

Key/custody notes:
- Operators will carry an HSM-backed USB token (FIPS 140-2 certified) for key unwrap operations. We will not leave tokens in courier custody at any point.
- Prior to signing we require the EdgeOps courier to present government ID; our teammate will photograph the ID and append to acceptance-log.
- For the expedited patch path: Redwood will provide a KMS public-wrapping token and the HSM will perform unwrap only after dual operator consent (biometric + PIN).

Please confirm the following by EOD Monday:
1) EdgeOps confirms they will include the emergency packet descriptor in manifest-v3.json under emergency_signers and the courier batch id for fast-tracking, and
2) Containr confirms the sealed crate serial CR-EO-4432-77 matches their waybill.

-Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Field Ops (Redwood Inference)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Aaron Hollis <aaron.hollis@edgeops.io>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sterile site delivery proposal + ETA for signed artifact bundle

All — thank you. EdgeOps / Containr: this looks good from Redwood's side. Confirmed items: 
- Acceptance window locked: 2027-04-30 10:00-13:00 PT
- CR-EO-4432-77 matches the waybill we received from Containr and the manifest digest matches our verifier run locally
- Emergency patch path approved with conditions (dual-sign, HSM unwrap with operator biometric + PIN, photo witness log)

Next actions: 
- Aaron: please confirm emergency_signers block and courier fast-track process by Tue EOD; we will publish a short runbook for the team and push the offline verifier to our secure repo (HS-3245).
- Jonas / Kimberly: prepare the acceptance USB with verifier script and an empty acceptance-log template
- Marissa: I'll loop legal on the chain-of-custody signature language for the transfer form (cc'd earlier threads)

If anything changes (ETA slips, signer roster changes), flag immediately.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions (Redwood Inference)
